Enjoy a glass of sparkling wine to start, with the option to switch to other drinks. The menu is designed to be enjoyable even for those who prefer non-alcoholic options. Please indulge in the dessert as well. Please note that this is a Ladies' Night course. Enjoy a delightful time with your friends at your girls' party!
